rows.note: Use this as the general word for an organization formed for a purpose.

example.english: This association specializes in helping low-income families.
example.traditional: 呢個組織專門幫助基層家庭。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zou2 zik1 zyun1 mun4 bong1 zo6 gei1 cang4 gaa1 ting4

rows.note: Use this for an association such as a professional, charitable, or interest-based association.

example.traditional: 我參加咗一個攝影協會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 caam1 gaa1 zo2 jat1 go3 sip3 jing2 hip3 wui6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing a society or organized community group rather than an organization in general.

example.english: This association often organizes volunteer activities.
example.traditional: 呢個社團成日搞義工活動。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 se5 tyun4 sing4 jat6 gaau2 ji6 gung1 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose word for a connection or affiliation with someone or something.

example.english: I don't have much association with this company.
example.traditional: 我同呢間公司冇乜關係。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 mou5 mat1 gwaan1 hai6
